# Chinese serif fallback

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoserifsc

Noto Serif SC, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt).

`blog-serif-sc.woff2` is a static weight-400 subset containing the current Markdown corpus, UI, Latin-1 and GB2312 characters (7,700 requested characters, supported glyphs retained). Generated with FontTools from NotoSerifSC[wght].ttf. The source's glyph artwork is unchanged. The font is used only when preferred local serif fonts do not cover a character; unsupported future characters fall through to system fonts.
